# V Grand Infra

> V Grand Infra is a real estate and infrastructure company based in Ongole,
> Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh, India. Led by T. Vinod Kumar with 25+
> years of cross-industry experience, the company builds premium yet
> affordable gated community apartments and residential projects in Ongole
> and Koppolu, adjacent to the NH-16 highway. Homes start from ₹29 Lakhs.
> Projects are RERA registered (P08440065656).

## Contact

- Phone: +91 90301 43333
- Email: info@vgrandgroup.com
- Address: Koppolu, Ongole, Andhra Pradesh 523001, India
- Website: https://vgrandgroup.com

## Projects

- [Elite Homes](https://vgrandgroup.com/projects/elite-homes): First gated
  community in Koppolu near NH-16. Premium 3BHK apartments from ₹29 Lakhs.
- [V Grand Gateway](https://vgrandgroup.com/projects/v-grand-gateway):
  Premium 2 & 3 BHK flats in Ongole with modern amenities.
- [Tripura](https://vgrandgroup.com/projects/tripura): Affordable 2BHK
  homes in Ongole.
